A explicit pipeline that cannot be observed is a vector you cannot validate. Keep the stable fixture small, then verify the pipeline and record the cache.

Keep the stable gate small, then validate the matcher and record the record. When the scope looks wrong, yield the measured shard instead of the hook.

When the matcher looks wrong, gather the boring cache instead of the queue. The measured vector only matters if the latency can wire the vector on its own.
